weather.condition: Clear now, sunny and dry later
weather.quip: Open-Meteo has Mill Valley starting Saturday at 55°, feeling like 54°, clear, humid but not swampy, with a tiny south-southwest breeze around 3 mph. The day should climb to about 80° with basically no rain, UV around 7.7, sunrise at 6:19 AM, and sunset at 8:11 PM. Morning is gentle. Afternoon is sunscreen with confidence.
